newsitem.title: GERMANY: Issing, Tietmeyer to attend Bonn meeting on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Issing, Tietmeyer to attend Bonn meeting on Friday.

text.p: Bundesbank Chief Economist Otmar Issing said on Thursday that he and Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer would attend a cabinet meeting in Bonn on Friday to discuss Germany's supplementary budget for 1997 and the 1998 budget.

Issing declined to comment on the Bonn government's announcement that it plans to sell oil reserves and to tighten social security spending in a bid to meet entry criteria for European currency union.
Issing said he and Tietmeyer would learn more of the government's plans when they attend the cabinet meeting.
Once a year it is routine for Bundesbank and parliamentary officials to meet the cabinet to discuss the government's draft budget and mid-term financial planning.
